(pinned F0/F1/F2, accepts dropped fold), effective_instants() (51), targets_at(instant, universe=..., stress=...) (raises EligibilityShortfall on <12 eligible; returns the FLAT book with reason FOLD_TERMINAL_FORCE_FLAT at 2025-12-15), fills_at(...), marks_at(...), settlements(sym), funding_cashflows_for_spans(spans), rebalance_cost_between(prev, new, prices=..., stress=...), declared_execution_lag(), price_only_gate_input_spec(). run_strategy(plugin, stress=...) works unmodified (proven in tests).

frozen_conventions_implemented.signal: b_i(T) = mean p_b over the trailing 2688 (anchor) / 5376 (neighbour) COMPLETED 15m basis-route buckets with close <= T; every slot present AND available else the symbol refuses (fail-closed, L-V12-5); last admissible bucket [Sun 23:45, Mon 00:00); premium/mark/index klines, OI and funding-rate DECLARED OUT OF SCOPE for the signal (proposal section 10)
frozen_conventions_implemented.book: long floor(n_eligible/3) lowest-premium / short floor(n_eligible/3) highest-premium, equal 1/(2 floor(n/3)) per leg, gross 1.0, ranks ascend by (b_i, symbol id), middle flat, min 12 eligible (else EligibilityShortfall), max|w| = 1/8 = 0.125 <= 0.30 by construction (asserted), BTCUSDT never ranked
frozen_conventions_implemented.arms: anchor 28D / neighbour 56D / control 28D-INV = EXACT element-wise sign inversion of the anchor book (test-pinned)
frozen_conventions_implemented.clock: weekly Monday 00:00:00Z; fills at the close of the first completed 15m bar strictly after T (00:15Z close; stress +1 => 00:30Z close); holding 7d force-flat-clamped at fold ends
frozen_conventions_implemented.folds: F0 2025-08-22..2025-12-21 / F1 2025-12-22..2026-04-21 / F2 2026-04-22..2026-08-21; 1-day purge as the TRAILING calendar zone of each fold (V11-lineage purge_fold_members convention inherited by the V12 frozen fold contract and the V13 implementation); exactly one stamp (2026-04-20) purged => 51 effective Mondays at 17/17/17; F0 fold-terminal stamp 2025-12-15 answered with the FLAT book (no position crosses a fold boundary)
frozen_conventions_implemented.costs: L-V14-0 remediated kernel inherited from the generic adapter: charged on fills only (weight deltas), real perp tick sizes, funding settled once on held legs (start < ts <= end), identical across arms; scored cells must report cost broken out by fills vs holding terms (driver obligation)
